reference.B: new 70-second composition at 1.0x, real expanded local voice

captions.alignment: Piper/VITS intrinsic phoneme durations verified against emitted samples, mapped through actual tempo duration and acoustic silence splices; tolerance 35ms

comparisonLimit: Pixel activity is not a perceptual quality score. New narrator has a different timbre; A/B allows direct listening. No automatic metric proves subjective equivalence.
